title: dev.lembos.check.failed
description: A check found something the platform depends on not working: a target unreachable, a credential refused, a blueprint version that cannot be fetched. Version 1.

subject.description: What was checked: an execution-target, a credential or a blueprint.

type.description: The entity type, in the platform's kebab-case: component, resource, environment, release, execution-target, credential, blueprint, webhook.

check.description: Which check: Connection for a target, Availability for a blueprint version, and for a credential the use it was checked for — Identity, SourceAccess, Directory.

scope.description: Which part of it: a credential's source type, a blueprint's version tag.

status.description: What the check found: Unauthorized, Unreachable or Misconfigured — and for a blueprint version also NotFound, DigestMismatch or Error.

owner.description: The group that owns what the event is about.

link.description: Where it is put right, in the Portal.
